packet_hash_method: Delete only the top-level packet_sha256 self-field; serialize the remaining JSON with sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=False; hash the resulting UTF-8 bytes with SHA-256.
statement_hash_method: SHA-256 directly over the UTF-8 bytes of the lean.statement string, including its final newline.
context_hash_method: SHA-256 over the UTF-8 canonical sorted compact JSON serialization of the approved_definition_context array, with ensure_ascii=False.

isolation.method: Read the single permitted packet and reconstruct only from its displayed proposition and approved definitions. Hash calculations used only that packet. No directory listing, repository search, external lookup, compilation, or source comparison was performed.

observations: The outer choices are universal: natural d,n satisfying 3 <= n <= d, real kappa >= 4, and an arbitrary family of full real orthogonal matrices.
The explicit coordinate equivalence sends full-block coordinate (i,j) to j*n+i, and remaining coordinate i to q*n+i.
False selects forward multiplication O_j v; true selects transpose multiplication O_j^T v, which is inverse multiplication by orthogonality.
The block formula uses both displayed query values; the remaining coordinates are copied by g.
HasGradientAt is in the conclusion, so differentiability is asserted at every x and is not presumed from the totalized gradient operation.
The product equality asserts both the function-value formula and gradient equality.
No meaning beyond the packet is assigned to the proposition, and no source correspondence or compilation claim is made.
